resources.string: When you enable this service and explicitly ask for help, Irai can inspect visible screen text and form controls in apps and websites. Relevant visible text may be sent to the Irai AI service. Text typed into editable fields is excluded from screen-reading requests. After you approve each action, Irai can tap controls, select options, enter ordinary text, and scroll. Assisted text entry is blocked for passwords, payment cards, banking details, PINs, and verification codes. Irai does not intentionally inspect screens in the background.
